name: atr_14
description: Wilder ATR(14) on mid-OHLC, shifted 1 to use bars closed strictly before signal.

name: atr_percentile_100
description: Trailing-100 percentile rank of Wilder ATR(14). 0..1 (1 = highest vol in the trailing window). Uses strictly prior bars only.

name: atr_vs_trailing_100
description: Wilder ATR(14) at signal bar (computed on prior data) divided by the mean of the trailing 100-bar ATR series. >1 ⇒ vol expansion.

name: d1_atr_percentile_100
description: Trailing-100 percentile rank of D1 Wilder ATR(14). Computed on the lag-1 D1 series so it's strictly prior at the signal bar.

name: d1_close_slope_magnitude
description: Absolute D1 close-on-close change (lag-1). Pair with d1_close_slope_sign for directional + magnitude features.

name: d1_close_slope_sign
description: Sign of the prior-D1 close-on-close slope. -1 / 0 / +1. Uses the L_PROTOCOL §1 one-day-lag rule (D1 bar from calendar day T-1 visible at T).

name: day_of_week
description: UTC weekday (Mon=0..Sun=6).

name: distance_to_round_number
description: Minimum pip distance from prior mid-close to the nearest of three round-number grids (0.0050 / 0.0100 / 0.0500 price units).

name: dollar_bloc_state
description: Average signed 1-bar mid-return of dollar-bloc currencies (USD, CAD, AUD, NZD) vs the non-bloc complement. Proxy for risk-on/off bloc moves.

name: eur_strength_index
description: Average signed 1-bar mid-return of EUR across all EUR-bearing pairs at the prior bar. +ve = EUR strengthening. SUSPECT pending Step 6 audit.

name: hour_of_day
description: UTC hour of the bar's left edge (0-23).

name: kijun_26_distance
description: Distance from prior mid-close to prior Kijun-sen(26). Positive = price above Kijun. Shifted 1 — uses strictly prior bars only.

name: prior_session_high_distance
description: Distance from the prior-bar mid-close to the prior-calendar-day's bid-side session high. Positive ⇒ above prior day's high.

name: prior_session_low_distance
description: Distance from the prior-bar mid-close to the prior-calendar-day's ask-side session low. Positive ⇒ above prior day's low.

name: range_close_ratio
description: Prior-bar (high - low) / close. Bar-1 volatility proxy.

name: session_dead
description: Dead-zone flag — UTC 21-07 (wraps midnight).

name: session_ldn_ny_overlap
description: London/NY overlap flag (UTC 12-16).

name: session_london
description: London session flag (UTC 07-16).

name: session_ny
description: NY session flag (UTC 12-21).

name: session_tokyo
description: Tokyo session flag (UTC 00-09).

name: signal_density_28
description: Count of pairs whose prior-bar mid-range exceeds that pair's trailing-100 mean range. 0..28. Coarse universe-volatility proxy.

name: spread_percentile_100
description: Trailing-100 percentile rank of the prior-bar spread. 0..1.

name: spread_vs_trailing_100
description: Prior-bar spread divided by mean of the trailing 100-bar spread. >1 ⇒ widening spread regime.

name: swing_high_distance_14
description: Distance from prior mid-close to the 14-bar trailing swing high (also on prior bars). Positive — swing high is above current close.

name: swing_low_distance_14
description: Distance from prior mid-close to the 14-bar trailing swing low. Positive — current close is above the swing low.

name: usd_strength_index
description: Average signed 1-bar mid-return of USD across all USD-bearing pairs at the prior bar. +ve = USD strengthening. SUSPECT pending Step 6 audit of the cross-pair alignment + ffill semantics.

name: w1_close_slope_sign
description: Sign of the prior-W1 close-on-close slope. -1 / 0 / +1. Strictly prior W1 bar (no exact-match alignment — week N's bar isn't visible until week N+1 starts).
